usedFor: Mailparser turns emails into structured data, and Brevo stores the sender when “New Email Parsed” runs “Add Or Update Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Email Parsed” in Mailparser, then “Add Or Update Contact” in Brevo
bestTemplate.why: Parsed lead emails create a Brevo contact, or update the one already there.

watchOut: “New Parsed Email (one request per row)” fires per row, so one email can run “Add Or Update Contact” repeatedly.
